fieldConvention: Each operations.facts entry is required in the reviewed design. Existing disclosure predicates are identified separately from proposed narrow extensions requiring GPT approval. OPEN is a design blocker, not a new public Availability enum.

Actual successful fresh submission: immediate facts are captured from the one real execution and its real pre/post state. Rejected/duplicate attempts never gain a synthetic payment/damage/settlement delta. Applicable current observations stay separate.

A retained terminal fact may name its resolving receipt only through an explicit native causal join. No equality of time/actor/nearby revision is accepted. Missing cause is separately NotRetained while actual terminal value may remain an authorized current observation.

For all field groups: evaluate family authority before record lookup/applicability/count/cause/value. Protected families use fixed declared keys with Withheld; no hidden counts or hidden per-record placeholders. Current operatorClockGrant does not satisfy any Player/Work/Inventory predicate.

Collection rows include only identifiers authorized by the named existing/proposed predicate. There is no total native count, hidden-count, omitted-count, has-hidden, or raw array export. Multi-record facts repeat fixed keys with authorized subject causal identity, in native/ordinal order as specified.

Costs, prospective output alternatives, fixed recipes and planned duration are descriptions/assessments, not actual-result facts. Actual booked intervals and actual reserved claims are committed state; work progress is labor actually earned.

Actual registry review03: conditional future obligations are separately typed descriptors, never facts with Immediate/Retained/ObservedCurrent. Current native remaining-work counters and real scheduled bookings describe committed state, not earned future labor.

Only authoritative post-rollback outcome is projected. A failed candidate AdvanceTo does not establish paid time, ingredients, dice or outputs. Immediate fields requiring commit are NotApplicable on a rejected rolled-back attempt.
Every fact key is fixed in its operation family; select visibility before native existence/applicability/value, never export hidden reactor/observer count or one placeholder per hidden element.

The narrow predicates below describe an explicitly UNAPPROVED proposal, not an authorization acquired from source existence. Existing view routes are semantic evidence; their transitive purity is not assumed.
CurrentObservation/CurrentContinuation keys use ObservedCurrent only. Retained names immutable actual commit facts with explicit native joins, not the current value of an overwritten mutable record.

No Restore, AdvanceTo, lifecycle reducer, save replay, RNG reconstruction or resolver-on-copy is called to manufacture read results. Any required lifecycle/geometry reader without a reviewed pure path yields field-specific ProjectionUnavailable, while committed outcome remains intact.
Primitive null states are represented by Availability, never numeric zero/empty identity standing in for absent private records. Known absent optional values require authorized applicability first.

joins.ORD_HIDE: ExplorationHideAttempt.Revision+CommandId -> own start. End.Revision+CommandId -> separate actual cancellation/interruption/completion. End.ObservationId is private internal exact join to observation action only, not exported. Multiple end events on same receipt retain native order.

joins.GUIDANCE: GuidanceUseRecord.CommandId+Revision+ActorId+CheckId (actual observation action ID) -> exact execution; native check kind verifies. Own public spent fact may be recorded, never effect/source IDs exported merely from use existence.

joins.CLOCK_EVENT: Exact own receipt matches native CommandId+Revision (or ArrivalCommandId+ArrivalRevision); event At is actual reached boundary, not inferred from requested duration. Only event-specific retained fields qualify. AdvanceTo candidate errors may rollback completely.
joins.EXIT: ClosedEncounterRecord.ClosedRevision -> actual EndFixedEncounter receipt; Reason==command.Id (Reason is command identity, NOT public failure text); closed.Encounter is outgoing. First closure can be LaterEncounter.FirstExit, later/Recovery/Ferry in ClosedEncounters. No record at receipt means no retained actual close proof; immediate execution outcome required.
